credits.title: Summer High
credits.overview: In 1987, two police officers with polar-opposite personalities must team up for the biggest case of their lives when thousands of cans filled with marijuana wash up on Brazilian beaches, threatening to plunge the country into total chaos.

credits.title: Maps
credits.overview: Julia and Sérgio set out in search of Rebeca, a missing cycling activist, moving through Brasília, a city marked by silence and unresolved histories. credits.title: Notary of Souls
credits.overview: Laura, a “young woman” of 126 years old, is the newly hired at Notary of Souls. In her new role, she records the motivations of those who renounced eternity. However, by contract, Laura herself cannot interrupt her tedious existence.

credits.title: O Cheiro do Seu Cabelo
credits.overview: On his eighth birthday, Feijão longs to visit the home of the grandmother he's never met. Guided by a familiar scent, he encounters a girl in the woods. What begins as a game unfolds into a suspended time where inherited wounds finally find rest.

credits.title: Virgínia e Adelaide
credits.overview: Adelaide and Virgínia met in 1937, a year after the German arrived in Brazil, fleeing the Nazi persecution of the Jews, where she came with her husband and two daughters. credits.title: Três
credits.overview: The daily life of a threesome.

credits.title: IRON - O Homem da Máscara de Ferro
credits.overview: A loose stage adaptation of the classic by Alexandre Dumas, told as an interactive electropop musical experience, breaking the boundaries between stage and audience.

credits.title: Infinitas Terras (Ou Relatos do Meu Tempo Crise)
The Pastor and the Revolutionary
credits.overview: O Pastor e o Guerrilheiro is a Brazilian feature film inspired by a true story, which takes place in the 1960s and 1970s and at the turn of the millennium - in the last days of 1999.

credits.title: Amado
credits.overview: Directed by Edu Felistoque and Erik de Castro, the film "Amado" was inspired by a real events. Blind to color, creed or sex, the police officer doesn't care if the individual is a thief or a policeman.

credits.title: Andrômeda
credits.overview: Young Júlia finds herself in a moment of emotional apathy after the end of a relationship. One night, after receiving unexpected news, she decides to cross the city in search of an old pinball table called “Andromeda”, to which she has many memories attached.

credits.title: A Cisterna
credits.overview: Lorena is an ambitious television host on her way to success when she is kidnapped and kept in an underground cistern. This leads her to face her fears and uncover her antagonists.
